### MyFitnessPal {#review-app-1}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Prix et paywall.**
      2 avis récents mentionnent prix et paywall.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 12 sept. 2026 - 15 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent prix, abonnements ou paywalls. Cela peut signaler une sensibilité au pricing dans la niche.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _NoBoundaryLearning_, 15 sept. 2026, 1/5: "Choosing the “sign up with Apple” option has totally broken my data ownership. I bought a premium plan, but I’m still forever paywalled. Was unable to sync recipes and had to re-install the app, went to log in and was forced to re-subscribe as there is no “Restore” option. Was then double billed for the annual plan. And guess what…still can’t get by the paywall. It’s ridiculous this company is vibe coding their authentication and payment system. Please refund me both charged subscriptions so I can take my money to a different app."
            2. _MyFitnessFail ❌_, 12 sept. 2026, 1/5: "Will not renew Premium.I would leave zero stars if I could. After the update, I actually thought I had forgotten to renew my Premium subscription because the interface was so unrecognizable.It is a massive bummer because I used to be able to see everything clearly on one page. Now, everything is buried. I spent 10 minutes hunting for old features and refuse to waste any more time. It feels like developers just move things around for the sake of it, thinking it’s "better" when it actually makes the app frustrating to use.I will absolutely NOT be renewing my Premium subscription when it comes due. Please bring back the old version."
<!--/ir-theme-->

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Pression publicitaire.**
      1 avis récent mentionne pression publicitaire.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 15 sept. 2026 - 15 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs remarquent la pression publicitaire. Cela signale une friction de monétisation et une ouverture pour un concurrent plus propre.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Skimbon_, 15 sept. 2026, 3/5: "Used myfitness pal for years both premium and free versions. It's OK but increasingly finding the barcode scanner brings up the wrong food and too much stuff in the database is wrong. They recently changed the UI and it's simply worse and despite feedback from their customers. I suspect the change is a way of making you click through more pages so they can have more ads on them. Def won't ever do premium again in its current state"
<!--/ir-theme-->

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      7 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 19 juil. 2026 - 15 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _LoriLins64_, 16 août 2026, 1/5: "Note: I am a paid user, and have been using MFP for a couple of years now, quite happily. But this new update is absolutely horrific, the worst I’ve ever seen. They took a very user-friendly app and made it ridiculously unusable. What used to be very simple is now a frustrating exercise and having to navigate through many screens and not being able to even see your macros, or how many you have left. I actually hate it. I wish there was a way to refer to the previous version. As soon as I find a replacement, I will be canceling my subscription and deleting this monstrosity from my phone."
            2. _Anne Dlh_, 23 juil. 2026, 1/5: "L’application bug dès la première utilisation. Je ne vous recommande pas d’utiliser une application qui vous indique de consommé que 1400 kCal par jour pour une femme… Vous obtiendrez l’inverse de votre objectif. Vous allez perturber votre corps et votre santé mentale. Et pour certaines, développer des TCA… Bien tenté mais non merci."
            3. _Sweetnasty22_, 15 sept. 2026, 2/5: "They keep updating the app and it keeps getting slower and more broken."
